tool_args.prompt:
Create one complete transparent-background Armadura, ORIGINAL Resident Evil 4 (2005), EXACTLY the BLACK-and-GOLD closed-helmet armor with RED plume that stands in the FOREGROUND CENTER of reference1 and appears in reference2. Ignore and exclude silver knights, human player, HUD and all scenery. Keep the original angular dark metal plates and subdued gold trim, gold cross visor on the closed cylindrical helmet, long segmented armored legs and pointed boots. No human skin, parasite, glowing eyes or new ornaments. One complete source axe with long reddish-brown wooden shaft. ONLY the front end has the original metal spear point and the broad curved lower axe blade. The REAR BUTT is a plain blunt shaft end: absolutely no extra spear point, metal cone or second blade at the rear.
CRITICAL PHYSICAL HAND OWNERSHIP: he holds this axe with the ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand FORWARD, CLOSER TO THE AXE HEAD, and the ANATOMICAL LEFT hand REARWARD, closer to the BLUNT SHAFT BUTT. This identity must stay true as he turns; do not swap hands to imitate a mirrored pose. Render a clear SIDE-DOMINANT THREE-QUARTER PROFILE facing SCREEN-RIGHT, with his anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm on the near side. Trace that near RIGHT upper arm to its elbow and extend its forearm diagonally forward-right so the RIGHT gauntlet is unmistakably the FORWARD grip nearest the blade. The far LEFT arm bends back near the torso, with LEFT gauntlet on the REAR part of the shaft, closer to the body and blunt butt. The far left forearm may be naturally partly occluded behind the near arm; do not replace it with an extra hand. Along the horizontal shaft from SCREEN-LEFT to SCREEN-RIGHT the order is: BLUNT REAR BUTT, LEFT-hand rear grip, RIGHT-hand forward grip, AXE HEAD and FRONT SPEAR POINT. Keep both arms and wrists anatomically connected. Hold the axe at waist/lower-chest height without crossed detached limbs.
Helmet, chest, knees and both pointed feet aim RIGHT, not a square frontal stance. Complete one enemy only; include red plume tip, both shoes, every weapon endpoint and all blade edges. Scale down character and axe together until at least 10 percent transparent space surrounds the entire silhouette on every edge. Preserve the slightly angular textured original-game look, no modern remake, no new medieval design. Genuine clean transparent alpha, no floor, backdrop shadow, wall, glow, border, label, logo, watermark, text, UI, extra knight or sprite grid. Independent physical rotation, never software mirroring. One static visual candidate with inferred hidden surfaces, not certified native model geometry or animation.
